---
title: "Rolling Dice"
---

## Rolling Dice Experiment

Click the button to roll a fair six-sided die. The histogram and sample average update dynamically.

```{=html}
<div id="dice-demo" style="max-width: 760px; margin-top: 1em;">
  <button onclick="rollDie()" style="padding: 8px 14px; font-size: 16px;">
    Roll a die
  </button>

  <button onclick="resetDiceDemo()" style="padding: 8px 14px; font-size: 16px; margin-left: 8px;">
    Reset
  </button>

  <p id="dice-result" style="font-size: 18px; margin-top: 1em;">
    No rolls yet.
  </p>

  <p id="dice-counts">
    Total rolls: 0
  </p>

  <p id="dice-avg">
    Average: 0
  </p>

  <svg id="dice-histogram" width="700" height="330"></svg>
</div>

<script>
let diceCounts = [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0];
let diceSum = 0;

function rollDie() {
  const result = Math.floor(Math.random() * 6) + 1;

  diceSum = diceSum + result;
  diceCounts[result - 1] += 1;

  document.getElementById("dice-result").innerText = "Latest roll: " + result;
  updateDiceDisplay();
}

function resetDiceDemo() {
  diceCounts = [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0];
  diceSum = 0;

  document.getElementById("dice-result").innerText = "No rolls yet.";
  updateDiceDisplay();
}

function updateDiceDisplay() {
  const total = diceCounts.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
  const average = total === 0 ? 0 : diceSum / total;

  document.getElementById("dice-counts").innerText =
    "Total rolls: " + total;

  document.getElementById("dice-avg").innerText =
    "Average: " + average.toFixed(3);

  drawDiceHistogram();
}

function drawDiceHistogram() {
  const svg = document.getElementById("dice-histogram");
  svg.innerHTML = "";

  const width = 700;
  const height = 330;
  const marginLeft = 50;
  const marginBottom = 55;
  const chartHeight = 210;
  const barWidth = 60;
  const gap = 40;
  const maxValue = Math.max(...diceCounts, 1);

  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
    const value = diceCounts[i];
    const x = marginLeft + i * (barWidth + gap);
    const barHeight = (value / maxValue) * chartHeight;
    const y = height - marginBottom - barHeight;

    const rect = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "rect");
    rect.setAttribute("x", x);
    rect.setAttribute("y", y);
    rect.setAttribute("width", barWidth);
    rect.setAttribute("height", barHeight);
    rect.setAttribute("fill", "#4C78A8");
    svg.appendChild(rect);

    const faceLabel = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "text");
    faceLabel.setAttribute("x", x + barWidth / 2);
    faceLabel.setAttribute("y", height - 25);
    faceLabel.setAttribute("text-anchor", "middle");
    faceLabel.textContent = i + 1;
    svg.appendChild(faceLabel);

    const countLabel = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "text");
    countLabel.setAttribute("x", x + barWidth / 2);
    countLabel.setAttribute("y", y - 8);
    countLabel.setAttribute("text-anchor", "middle");
    countLabel.textContent = value;
    svg.appendChild(countLabel);
  }

  const axis = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "line");
  axis.setAttribute("x1", marginLeft - 10);
  axis.setAttribute("y1", height - marginBottom);
  axis.setAttribute("x2", width - 40);
  axis.setAttribute("y2", height - marginBottom);
  axis.setAttribute("stroke", "black");
  svg.appendChild(axis);

  const xAxisLabel = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "text");
  xAxisLabel.setAttribute("x", width / 2);
  xAxisLabel.setAttribute("y", height - 5);
  xAxisLabel.setAttribute("text-anchor", "middle");
  xAxisLabel.textContent = "Die outcome";
  svg.appendChild(xAxisLabel);
}

drawDiceHistogram();
</script>
```
